node.label: American Broadcasting Company
node.definition: American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. (doing business as American Broadcasting Company, abbreviated as ABC) is an American commercial broadcasting television network that serves as the flagship property of the Disney Television Group division of the Walt Disney Company.
